patch_description: Introduce horizontal vs. vertical edge splits for all edge-related single-qubit rotations across pre- and post-entangling layers, and split hub-entanglement parameters into two edge groups. This provides anisotropic correlation patterns aligned with board geometry while preserving symmetry. The changes are isolated to the ANSATZ_SPEC construction (no changes to data, feature map, training loop, or measurements). This should improve expressivity and potentially reduce generalization error by enabling more structured parameter sharing across symmetric positions.
